questions_after.question: How are cash cost, AISC, all-in cost and 'AISC excluding third-party buy-in' defined and reconciled to IFRS cost of production for FY26/FY25, and do the Group per-oz figures (1,600/1,867/2,576 US$/oz) tie to the ZAR million cost tables on p.50 at the 16.90 US$/ZAR rate?
questions_after.target_section: D008 Alternative performance measures (ALL-IN COSTS, p.40-43); D010 Glossary
questions_after.evidence_required: Definition and build-up of each cost metric, treatment of third-party buy-in feedstock and by-product credits, and reconciliation of per-unit costs to ZAR/A$ million cost-of-production totals for FY26 and FY25.
questions_after.closure_condition: Definitions and a reconciliation tying Group per-oz costs to the p.50 cost-of-production totals (same period, currency, gross/net basis) are shown, or the difference is explained.

questions_after.question: Are the p.49 outliers genuine or typographical: Elikhulu ZAR all-in cost FY25 68,843 ZAR/kg (vs FY26 853,597); Tennant A$ all-in cost FY25 1,584,835 A$/kg (vs FY26 205,143); Tennant US$ all-in cost FY25 32,041 US$/oz (vs FY26 4,339)?
questions_after.evidence_required: Corrected or corroborating figures for these cells with the underlying cost and production inputs, and confirmation of units (ZAR/kg, A$/kg, US$/oz).
questions_after.closure_condition: Each outlier is either confirmed as printed (with explanation of the one-off) or corrected with a stated figure and source.

questions_after.question: Why does FY25 'Total operations MTR' gold produced (30,806 oz) exceed the MTR operation component (25,043 oz) by 5,763 oz, when the FY26 buy-in row shows 5,763 oz for MTR but FY25 buy-in shows nil?
questions_after.evidence_required: Breakdown of FY25 MTR total production by source (own tailings vs buy-in vs other) and confirmation whether the 5,763 oz is a misclassification or a genuine additional source.
questions_after.closure_condition: The 5,763 oz difference is explained and the component-to-total reconciliation for MTR FY25 is shown.

questions_after.question: Is Tennant's revenue (A$195.3m FY26; A$5.9m FY25) excluded from the Group ZAR revenue total of 17,249.1 ZARm, and how is the Australian operation consolidated into Group revenue and Adjusted EBITDA (US$663.1m)?
questions_after.target_section: D006.2 Segment analysis (p.20-24); D005 Primary financial statements (p.17-19)
questions_after.evidence_required: Group revenue by currency/segment and the consolidation/FX translation treatment of Tennant, reconciling A$ revenue to Group ZAR revenue and to Adjusted EBITDA.
questions_after.closure_condition: Tennant's contribution to Group revenue and EBITDA is reconciled with currency translation shown, or exclusion is confirmed.
